recipe.visualDefinition: A highly symmetrical, black-and-white composition set in a formal courtroom. A central figure breaks the pattern of seated men by turning to face the camera directly, creating a focal point of defiance or inquiry within a rigid institutional structure.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the left and right rows of seated men in dark suits
Contrast between the uniform backs of the group and the single direct gaze of the central subject
Framing of the central subject by the architectural semi-circular arch and the judge's bench
Leading lines from the foreground pews toward the central figure
coreInvariants: One figure looking back at the viewer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is seated slightly off-center but framed centrally, scaled to occupy the middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The judge's bench and the large decorative arch behind it serve as the structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye enters through the foreground pews, follows the line of seated men toward the center, and locks onto the subject's eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is largely empty wall space, emphasizing the weight and gravity of the scene below.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays define the suits and furniture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mid-tone grays define the walls and architectural details.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright whites on shirt collars provide sharp rhythmic highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between dark silhouettes and the neutral background.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical courtroom scene in black and white. Include a large semi-circular arch on the back wall, a judge's bench, and two rows of men in dark suits with white collars sitting with their backs to the camera. Ensure one man in the center is turned around, looking directly at the lens.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a stark, minimalist sans-serif or a traditional serif like a legal document, placed in the upper negative space or lower foreground pews.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the symmetry maintained across the horizontal axis?
Is the central figure's gaze clear and direct?

adjustableVariables: Specific architectural details of the arch
The expression of the central subject
mustRedesign: Any specific flags or insignias to avoid copyright issues
Specific facial features of the subjects to ensure original character generation

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the central subject
Rich tonal range from deep black to crisp white

postGenerationChecks: Check for exactly one person looking at the camera.
Verify the presence of the semi-circular arch.
Ensure the lighting creates a somber, cinematic mood.
Confirm the absence of any color data.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Courtroom + Monochrome + Central Gaze + Institutional Architecture
